title: Legacy AC3 of a deed in lieu story tests the vehicle repossession rule R-DIS-01
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, RWB-E3-020 AC3; FSD S5 A2.2.3.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s8 Business rules
description: RWB-E3-020 is a property take-on after a deed in lieu and its AC2 tests R-DIS-02, but its AC3 tests R-DIS-01 (asset_type = vehicle, statutory notice proved, repossession completed) and so duplicates RWB-E3-019 AC2. The FSD rule set of feature A2.2 also lists R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-03 next to R-DIS-02. The combined gap row for RWB-S5-E3020-APP and RWB-S5-E3020-CON: the AC is kept verbatim with its origin tag as the split rule requires, and the behaviour of the rule is owned by the sibling story, so no rule row is duplicated.
evidence: AC3 Given a case in state ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON / When repossession completed / Then create the asset record from RPS; FSD S5 A2.2.3.1 rows R-DIS-01, R-DIS-02 and R-DIS-03; RWB-E3-019 AC2 carries the same R-DIS-01 scenario.
proposed: Keep AC3 word for word with its origin tag; table R-DIS-02 as the rule of this step and name R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-03 as the sibling routes' rules owned by RWB-S5-E3019-APP and RWB-S5-E3021-APP.

title: The registered deed in lieu transfer contract RWB-S2-E3012-CON is absent from the contract-dependency row
source: WP B2-S5-002 story JSON (C = []); FSD S5 A2.2.2 prerequisites FEAT-TRT-14; Architecture v5 slide 41
section: Metadata; s3 Preconditions; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: The take-on cannot start without the fact that the transfer registered, and Architecture v5 slide 41 gives treatments, contracts, settlement and deed-in-lieu agreements to rwb-treatment (S2). No event of the rwb-asset catalogue carries that fact, so it is consumed on the S2 contract. The metadata row of this slice carries no contract dependency, so the row is read as class C and built against the published document and its fake. The operation name of the read is not published anywhere. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: FSD S5 A2.2.2 Integration points: ACE (v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_collateral; AMIS and CCMS ingested by ACE); Prerequisites FEAT-TRT-14; Architecture v5 slide 19 IN lists JudgmentRecorded, AuctionResult and ProceedsMatched only; no source names the operation.
area: S5 asset take-on / S2 treatment contract
proposed: Build against RWB-S2-E3012-CON and its fake from Day 1, carry the placeholder operation name, and add the row as class C in the next plan revision.

title: The asset table is absent from the Ownership Map although TSD S5 T3.1 and Architecture v5 give the asset record to S5
source: _work/msr/context/S5.md ownership rows (asset_sale, listing only); TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 T3.1; Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41
description: The context pack and the Ownership Map list only asset_sale and listing as S5 tables, while TSD S5 T3.1 defines the asset object with DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042 (the take-on columns, including transfer_in_type and book_value) and Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41 give rwb-asset the asset record. The record the take-on creates has no other owner in any source. Read as S5's own table in rwb_asset; recorded so the Ownership Map can be corrected. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: Ownership rows owned by S5: Tables (2) asset_sale, listing; TSD S5 T3.1 'asset (EXTEND ACE Asset)' with DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042; FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 field catalog reads v_ace_npa_asset for the ACE facts.
proposed: Treat asset as S5's record in rwb_asset, keep asset_sale and listing as the map gives them, and record the missing map row for Ownership Map v2.

title: The rwb-source-data data-product read that carries the ACE NPA asset and collateral facts has no published operation name
source: FSD S5 A2.2.2 and A2.6.3.2; Architecture v5 slides 29, 37 and 45; _work/msr/context/S5.md
section: s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: The legacy data of RWB-E3-020 names v_ace_npa_asset and v_ace_collateral, and the FSD field catalog reads them directly. In the target only rwb-source-data reads the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views and rwb-asset holds no v_ace_* grant, so DP-05 applies as a prohibition and the facts arrive on the DP06 Collateral and assets data product. No source names that read's operation, and no source states which of the asset fields are carried by the product. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: FSD S5 A2.2.2 Integration points; Architecture v5 slide 8 note 'the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views (read only by rwb-source-data)'; context pack: ACE data only through the owner's contract or v_ace_* views.
area: S5 asset take-on / P1 source data contract
proposed: Consume the DP06 Collateral and assets contract with a placeholder operation name and its fake, and pass the asset reference, asset code, asset type, segment, taken-on date, book value and collateral reference as the required fields.

title: Event 22 AssetTakenOn needs the outbox library of DP-09, which the pattern set and the build row of this key do not carry
source: Architecture v5 slide 19 OUT; slide 43 row 22; WP B2-S5-002 story JSON (patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19; H has no RWB-PLT-TE006-CON)
section: Metadata; s12.3 Events published; s13 Solution plan
description: The service publishes AssetTakenOn for rwb-case and rwb-payment, and a business event must leave from the outbox in the same transaction as the row, which is the DP-09 library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON. That library and its story are not in the pattern set of this key and not in its build row, so the event cannot be declared against a dependency the plan holds. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 19 OUT: topic rwb.asset.events.v1 with AssetTakenOn; slide 43 row 22 lists rwb-case and rwb-payment as consumers; DP table DP-09 -> H RWB-PLT-TE006-CON.
proposed: Keep the metadata row as the plan states it, record the library as a platform dependency of the published event, and take RWB-PLT-TE006-CON in the next plan revision.

title: The case-move answer of rwb-case has no published operation
source: FSD S5 A2.2.3.1 (Moves to ASSET_ON_BOOKS); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-02; Temporal and Drools Design slide 13
section: s9 State transitions; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: Every DISPOSAL rule ends in a case state that rwb-case owns, and on the workflow boundary the answer is the stage outcome that CaseWorkflow applies. No source names a published operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, and no field id exists for the agreement reference the answer carries. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: TSD S5 T4 R-DIS-02 To state ASSET_ON_BOOKS; Temporal and Drools Design slide 13 'each stage runs as a child workflow in the service that owns it'; recovery_case owner P3.
area: S5 asset take-on / P3 case contract
proposed: Answer the move as the stage outcome of the child workflow with the rule ID and its version, and carry the placeholder operation name until rwb-case publishes it.

title: No requirement id is allocated to legacy key RWB-E3-020 in the split plan
source: Business Requirements Program v4 (REQ-S5-001); WP B2-S5-002 story JSON (reqs = [])
description: The requirement the feature serves is REQ-S5-001 of the Business Requirements Program v4, and the split plan allocates neither that id nor a new one to this slice, so the traceability rows cite the program requirement and record the absence.
evidence: WP JSON reqs: []; TSD S5 T8 traces REQ-S5-001 to FEAT-AST-01 and marks the story as written one epic ahead.
proposed: Trace to REQ-S5-001 until the split plan allocates the requirement id of this key.

title: The Land Office registration has no service owner in the target
source: FSD S5 A2.2.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-02 systems column; Epics 3 to 8 Specification FEAT-AST-02
description: R-DIS-02 names the Land Office in its systems column and the feature links the case to the property once the transfer is registered, but no service models the registration and no integration id covers it. The registration is read as the registered transfer fact of the S2 contract and as an outside officer step. Combined gap row for the APP and the CON.
evidence: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-02 Systems: AMIS, the Land Office; FSD S5 A2.2.2 Integration points name ACE only; no integration row exists for the Land Office.
proposed: Model the registration only as the registered transfer fact of RWB-S2-E3012-CON and keep the registration itself as an officer and legal step outside every service.
